Here is a comprehensive `.env.example` file tailored for your Python RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) application.

### `.env.example`

```bash
# ==============================================================================
# Application Configuration
# ==============================================================================
# Flask / Application Environment (development, staging, production)
FLASK_ENV=development
FLASK_DEBUG=1
APP_HOST=0.0.0.0
APP_PORT=5000

# Secret key for session management and CSRF protection (generate a strong random key in production)
SECRET_KEY=your-super-secret-key-change-me-in-production

# ==============================================================================
# LLM / AI Model Settings
# ==============================================================================
# Primary LLM API Key (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace)
OPENAI_API_KEY=your_openai_api_key_here

# Alternative API Keys (Uncomment if using different providers)
# ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=your_anthropic_api_key_here
# HUGGINGFACEHUB_API_TOKEN=your_huggingface_token_here

# Model Selection
LLM_MODEL=gpt-4o-mini
LLM_TEMPERATURE=0.2
LLM_MAX_TOKENS=512

# ==============================================================================
# Embeddings & Vector Database Configuration
# ==============================================================================
# Embeddings Model Name
EMBEDDING_MODEL=text-embedding-3-small

# Vector Database Settings (e.g., chroma, faiss, qdrant, pinecone)
VECTOR_STORE_TYPE=chroma
VECTOR_STORE_PATH=./data/vector_store

# External Vector DB Settings (If using Pinecone/Qdrant/Milvus instead of local)
# PINECONE_API_KEY=your_pinecone_api_key
# PINECONE_INDEX_NAME=university-knowledge-base
# PINECONE_ENVIRONMENT=us-west1-gcp

# ==============================================================================
# RAG Ingestion & Chunking Parameters
# ==============================================================================
DOCUMENTS_DIR=./data/documents
CHUNK_SIZE=1000
CHUNK_OVERLAP=200
TOP_K_RESULTS=4

# ==============================================================================
# Logging & System Performance
# ==============================================================================
LOG_LEVEL=INFO
# Optional telemetry or tracking (e.g., LangChain / LangSmith tracing)
# LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2=true
# LANGCHAIN_API_KEY=your_langsmith_api_key
# LANGCHAIN_PROJECT=university-rag-bot
```
